lane: PANEL-ADOPT (TRUE-GREYBOX follow-on, PR #1514 merged as af1bd716) — crypt style iteration 2, ornamentation/carved-relief-density pass
goal: The crypt candidate (7.5 interim) trailed the incumbent (8.0) on ornamentation (carved reliefs/detail density). Run one more Gemini style pass on the SAME registered base (crypt_base_registered.png), strengthening carved-relief density using the incumbent crypt plate (candidate_crypt_armb_iter3.jpg) as a same-room style reference (content-hijack benign per THE REFERENCE-IMAGES LAW since the base is registered — docs/roadmap/PLATE-RECIPE-DECISION.md).
method: model_google-gemini-3-1-flash via the scenario MCP, referenceImages=[crypt_base_registered.png, candidate_crypt_armb_iter3.jpg], structure-lock + dimetric-lock prompt clauses, resolution 2K, aspectRatio 16:9, numOutputs 3 per batch.

a.read: BEST composition of batch 1: 2 pillars (one tall knotwork column, one shorter carved pillar) + 1 sarcophagus w/ knight-effigy + carved side relief, strong ornamentation gain. Drift: adds a partial staircase corner + a back archway/doorway not in crypt_geometry.json.

b.read: Rejected: hijacked composition toward the incumbent — adds a SECOND sarcophagus/plinth-with-relief, a full staircase, and dense perimeter frieze walls. Real collision-drift risk (extra tomb prop not in the manifest).

c.read: Rejected: adds a full staircase, a wall-mounted torch, and cobwebs not in crypt_geometry.json (matches the OLD incumbent's non-modeled flavor props, not this room's true-greybox geometry).

batch_1_loose_prompt.verdict: Loose prompt let Gemini's referenceImages hijack CONTENT (staircase / second tomb / perimeter friezes) beyond style, confirming the known gate limitation (edge-recall is content-blind, PLATE-RECIPE-DECISION.md open question #1491: it rewards busy imagery over faithful composition).

batch_2_hardened_structure_lock.prompt_change: Explicitly enumerated the ONLY allowed elements (perimeter wall, 1 brazier, 2 pillar STUBS at original small proportions, 1 sarcophagus) and explicitly forbade staircase/second-tomb/archway/wall-torch/cobwebs, directing the incumbent reference to ornamentation-density ONLY.

d.read: Clean: brazier + 1 pillar-stub in frame (tight crop) + sarcophagus w/ knight effigy + carved side panel. No staircase/archway/2nd tomb.

e.read: Rejected: still added a back archway/doorway with cobwebs, and its single pillar reads as a tall column rather than the original stub proportions.

f.read: SELECTED. Brazier + BOTH pillar stubs at correct proportions (rich carved knotwork relief) + 1 sarcophagus w/ knight-effigy + carved side relief, matching crypt_geometry.json's 3 props exactly. Only addition: a minor skull/bone pile + scattered leaf litter (thematic set-dressing, same class as the brazier itself — not a modeled prop but not collision-relevant; consistent with prior accepted crypt flavor clutter).

batch_2_hardened_structure_lock.overlay_check: crypt_iter2_candidate_f_overlay.png (greybox edge-mask in red over the candidate): back-left corner, back wall, and floor perimeter register cleanly with only a small residual shift — same magnitude/class as the ALREADY-ACCEPTED iter1 overlay (crypt_painterly_overlay.png, whose ~0.5c residual shift is documented as edge-NCC noise, not real drift). Registration evidence for collision/occlusion purposes stays on the BASE layer per the #1514 finding (base=registered, paint=cosmetic) — this overlay is corroborating/advisory evidence for the painterly final, consistent with PLATE-RECIPE-DECISION.md's treatment of organic/soft-painterly finals.

selected_candidate: crypt_iter2_candidate_f_SELECTED.jpg, staged as the new image_2 (label A) in qa/evidence/true-greybox/crypt/loop/panel/ for the full 5-scorer blind panel.
honesty_note: Recall-vs-greybox (edge alignment) is NOT the deciding metric here — it is content-blind and a busier/drift-prone candidate (b, c) can score HIGHER on recall than a faithful one (f) simply by adding more edges somewhere in frame. Candidate f was selected on COMPOSITION FIDELITY (matches crypt_geometry.json's exact prop set) + carved-relief density gain + a clean greybox-edge overlay, not on the recall number alone.
